posts.cooked: I would like to open a discussion about the excessive amount of bots that are running around. It was bad enough I had to see 10 druids in a row mining and herding in various places but now I see them doing the same thing with the tuskar lockboxes. This crap needs to stop, I am getting tired of reporting these various bots constantly. There needs to be a program that finds and bans the bots the same day. The herbs/mines are for players not for bots to enrich themselves.
